clue.text: Expect head to back social worker here in Paris

indicators.note: one piece goes to the back, coming after the others in the answer

parts.note: the ant is the classic social insect, living and working in colonies
the French for 'here' is ici
the pate is the top of the head

explanation.surface: Someone expects a senior figure to support a social worker based in Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: 'social worker' looks like a care professional; in crosswords it is often the ant, an insect that lives in colonies.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: to look forward to something happening is to expect it.

clue.text: One ringing hospital in pain

indicators.note: the first piece encircles the second, as a ring surrounds a finger

parts.note: an ace is a one in cards or dice
H is the standard abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

explanation.surface: Someone telephoning the hospital while suffering.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: a dull continuous hurt is a pain.

clue.text: Hears them, oddly, in Italian city

parts.note: a judge hears or tries a case in court

indicators.note: only the odd-numbered letters of the word them are kept

explanation.surface: Someone listens to people, strangely, in an Italian city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hears' is the courtroom sense: a judge hears, that is tries, a case. 'oddly' keeps T and E from 'them'.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the port at the head of the Adriatic is a city in Italy.

clue.text: Supercilious cheat going down

parts.note: to con someone is to cheat them
descending means going down

explanation.surface: An arrogant swindler is on his way down.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: both describe a haughty, patronising manner toward others.

clue.text: Meat dish in earthenware vessel on top of range, by oven

parts.note: a pot can be an earthenware vessel

indicators.note: only the top, that is the first letter, of the word range is used

parts.note: an oast is a kiln or oven for drying hops

explanation.surface: A cook places an earthenware pot on top of the range next to the oven.
explanation.walkthrough: 'range' looks like the kitchen stove but only gives its first letter. An OAST is a kiln for drying hops, familiar from Kent's oast houses.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a joint of beef browned and then cooked slowly in a covered vessel is a classic dish.

clue.text: Oscar on board cutting set of cards

indicators.note: a passenger on board is inside the vessel, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a cutting or tart remark is sharp
Oscar is O in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: An actor with an Oscar, sitting on a board, is cutting a deck of cards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cutting' reads as cutting a deck but is the adjective, sharp, giving TART.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a pack of picture cards used in fortune telling is a set of cards.

clue.text: One maintaining discipline in women's joint

parts.note: W is an abbreviation for women, as on clothing sizes or toilet doors
the hip is a joint of the body

explanation.surface: A strict figure keeps order in a women's bar.
explanation.walkthrough: A party whip is the official who keeps legislators voting the party line.
explanation.definitionFit: The parliamentary official charged with enforcing party loyalty is an enforcer of discipline.

clue.text: Special phone service arranged in hotel

indicators.note: the letters of the words are arranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A hotel has set up a dedicated telephone line for guests.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a dedicated direct telephone line for urgent calls or enquiries is a special service.

clue.text: Inclination to show compassion about poorly person

indicators.note: the first piece is placed about, or around, the second

parts.note: pity is a feeling of compassion

indicators.note: a poorly word is out of shape, its letters jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone tends to show compassion to a person who is unwell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'poorly' looks like it describes someone ill, but it is the anagram signal for the word beside it, giving ROPENS.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: a natural tendency or leaning toward something is an inclination.

clue.text: A woman may wear this headgear round Ireland, almost new

indicators.note: the first piece goes round the others

parts.note: a hat is headgear

indicators.note: the last letter of the synonym is dropped, so it is almost complete

parts.note: the word new taken as written

explanation.surface: A woman might wear this hat around Ireland when almost new to it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'headgear' looks like part of the definition but is the outer piece, HAT; 'almost' cuts NEW to NE.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a fine mesh holding hair in place is worn by women, notably in kitchens.

clue.text: Dish returned books to male teacher

indicators.note: the whole sequence is read backwards, as if turned back

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament, a set of books
pupils address a male teacher as sir

explanation.surface: A meal was sent back, along with some books, to a schoolmaster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' reverses OT TO SIR, so the whole string reads backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: an Italian rice preparation cooked in stock is a dish.

clue.text: A nasty fire cut off — by this at the Old Vic?

definitions.text: A nasty fire cut off — by this at the Old Vic?

indicators.note: something gone off is spoiled or out of order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dangerous blaze in a theatre is contained by a barrier.
explanation.walkthrough: The Old Vic is a London theatre; a fireproof screen lowered there would halt a fire spreading from stage to audience.
explanation.definitionFit: A fireproof screen between stage and auditorium is lowered to stop flames spreading in a theatre.

clue.text: Having rung from bar, behave improperly

parts.note: a rung of a ladder is a step
out of means from
a bar is a line, as a stripe

explanation.surface: Someone who has telephoned from the pub misbehaves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rung' looks like the past tense of ring (a phone call) but is the ladder rung.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to break the accepted rules of conduct is to behave improperly.

clue.text: Kick on, ahead of German runner

parts.note: to boot is to kick
on is the leg side in cricket

explanation.surface: A footballer kicks on, ahead of a German sprinter.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, the on side of the field is also called the leg side. 'runner' is a smuggler, not an athlete.
explanation.definitionFit: Crossword sense: a runner smuggles goods, and an illegal liquor trader is one.

clue.text: Accomplished players seen as dull

parts.note: a task accomplished is over, finished
a cast is the set of players in a show

explanation.surface: Skilled actors are judged boring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Accomplished' suggests skilled, but here means completed.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: a grey, cloud-covered sky is dull.

clue.text: Highlight mental pressure

definitions.meaning: strain or worry on the mind

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: emphasis placed on a point, and psychological strain.

clue.text: Had a wager about people initially liking band

indicators.note: the first piece goes about the others

parts.note: to bet is to have a wager
a race is a people

indicators.note: only the first letter of the word liking is used

explanation.surface: Someone bet on people taking to a music group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'band' looks like a music group but is a ring for the wrist.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: an ornamental ring worn round the wrist is a band.

clue.text: Italian knocked back sensible herbal drink

indicators.note: knocked back means turned backwards, so the abbreviation is reversed

parts.note: sane means sensible

explanation.surface: An Italian downs a reasonable herbal tea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked back' suggests drinking but reverses IT.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: an infusion of dried herbs or flowers is a herbal drink.

clue.text: Drink wine in comfort

parts.note: to sup is to drink
port is a fortified wine

explanation.surface: Someone takes a glass of wine for solace.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: to give emotional help to someone is to comfort them.

clue.text: Mad joke, finest around

parts.note: a crack is a joke

indicators.note: around means turned round, so the synonym is read backwards

parts.note: top means finest, the best

explanation.surface: A crazy gag is the best one doing the rounds.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: an eccentric or crazy person is mad; used as an adjective, it describes daft ideas.

clue.text: Have groups of searchers succeeded?

parts.note: posses are groups gathered to hunt someone down
S is an abbreviation for succeeded, as in genealogies

explanation.surface: A question asking whether search parties have triumphed.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: to own or hold something is to have it.

clue.text: Dire prospects affected morale

indicators.note: letters affected by something are changed, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Bleak prospects hit the team's spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: the French phrase for group spirit means shared morale.

clue.text: Wee drink before start of adapted play

indicators.note: the first piece comes before the second

parts.note: a dram is a small drink, especially of whisky

indicators.note: only the start, the first letter, of the word adapted is used

explanation.surface: A quick whisky before an adapted play starts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wee' is Scottish for small, fitting a dram of whisky.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: a theatrical work performed on stage is a play.

clue.text: Heard offspring give up

indicators.note: the clue word heard says the synonym is spoken, giving a word that sounds alike

parts.note: seed means offspring, as in biblical usage

explanation.surface: Someone was heard telling their children to quit.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: to surrender or yield territory or a right is to give it up.

clue.text: Black Sea country in a state

definitions.meaning: a nation in the Caucasus with a Black Sea coast
one of the fifty US states, capital Atlanta

explanation.surface: A Black Sea nation is in turmoil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a state' reads as 'agitated', but 'in' is a link and 'a state' is the second definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the Caucasus republic, and the American state named after King George II.

clue.text: Don't disturb English bishop during holiday

indicators.note: the inserted pieces come during, inside, the first

parts.note: leave is time off work, a holiday
B is the chess notation for bishop

explanation.surface: A request not to bother an English bishop while he is on holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to let someone alone without interference is to not disturb them.

clue.text: Speed of old car heading off

indicators.note: the head, the first letter, of the synonym comes off

parts.note: a crate is a slang term for a battered old car

explanation.surface: The pace of a vintage car as it sets off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading off' looks like departing but removes the first letter of CRATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: the pace or velocity at which something moves is its speed.

clue.text: Watch out for developments as we detain criminal

indicators.note: a criminal arrangement is a wrong one, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Police wait to see what happens while holding an offender.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to hold off acting until one sees how events unfold.
